archetype: water-retaining gravity dam with powerhouse, crest controls and twin planned refuge caverns
hydraulic_workflow: full impounded reservoir behind a curved reinforced gravity dam
four independently framed spillway throats and oxidized control gates
four concrete-clad penstocks descending to turbine-generator bays
four downstream tailraces returning water below the powerhouse
crest roadway and roomed gate-control/dispatch house
powerhouse operations, turbine hall, rear maintenance and elevated control gallery
refuge_program: separate downstream tunnel entrances and solid-log pressure thresholds
damage_constraints: preserve the complete dam body, reservoir and all four spillway paths
confine powerhouse damage to the eastern bay and roof
confine the separate crest failure to the control-house southeast corner
preserve both complete refugee plans, entrances, exits and crest ladders
derive deaths, debris and hostile occupation only from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: reservoir water is visibly retained against the upstream dam face
spillways, penstocks, turbines and tailraces read as one hydraulic system
powerhouse and crest controls have player-scale circulation
both refuges read as planned shelters rather than bed-filled caves
all tunnel, emergency and crest-ladder routes work in game
terrain feathering seats both abutments and the reservoir shoreline into generated terrain
